guide: GrowthCalculator(monthly, rate, years, lumpSum?, inflation?, title?, currency?) — a monthly investment (SIP) or recurring deposit the user drags; future value, invested, gain and the curve recompute live in the browser. rate is yearly % (12 = 12%). Pass lumpSum or inflation only when the user asked for them (each adds a slider). Use it for any 'what if I invest X a month' question instead of a VegaChart. Example: calc = GrowthCalculator(10000, 12, 15)

GrowthCalculator.description: A monthly investment (SIP) calculator with sliders; every number and the curve recompute live.

years.description: How many years the plan runs.

lumpSum.description: One-time amount invested at the start.

inflation.description: Yearly inflation in percent; adds a value in today's money.

currency.description: ISO currency code. Defaults to INR.
